purpose: Close numerical and dimension-matched comparisons; quantify evidence without requiring H/G superiority
status: Exploratory: all NHANES periods previously inspected
discovery: 2005-2008 only for fitting, rank choices fixed below

AJIVE.production_configuration: Use original AJIVE with reconsider_joint_components=True; this path correctly truncates the retained joint space. The local projection patch is diagnostic only, not used for production fits.
AJIVE.linear_algebra: Exact dense SVD, scipy gesvd, no simulated/relabelled method
AJIVE.7D_interpretation: Explicit full-budget stress test, not automatically selected AJIVE signal dimensionality
AJIVE.additional_reference: Default rank-reconsideration plus threshold-selected individual ranks, dimension reported rather than forced
AJIVE.protocol_revision_basis: Updated after discovery-only unsupervised pilot identified the joint-projection problem; no new holdout outcome tuning

downstream.hyperparameter_selection: Discovery-only cycle-stratified folds; feature scaling inside each fold
downstream.full_rank_fairness_check: Unpenalized weighted OLS predictions must be invariant across invertible 7D coordinates on identical rows

uncertainty.sampling: Paired Rao-Wu-style PSU rescaling using complete original DEMO frame within cycle and stratum
uncertainty.scope: Frozen fitted models; no training/model-selection error; unadjusted exploratory intervals
uncertainty.comparisons: Z5 and corrected AJIVE5/JIVE5 versus PCA5; all full-budget methods versus RawX7; H/G/combined versus covariates and each raw block

claim_rules: Never infer biological identification from block-specific loadings or reconstruction
Full-rank coordinate changes cannot add information beyond raw markers
Any advantage must name endpoint, comparator, dimensional budget, metric and period
Do not attribute a software/configuration error to the JIVE/AJIVE method in general
Corrected AJIVE results supersede the old comparator; preserve original files and label the correction
